_about: Everything this queen says in the Court. Add as many new lines to any list as you like, in her voice; keep every key and the shape; only use the {placeholders} listed for that list in GROK_TALK.md. A list here replaces the same list in config.json.

_who.name: Eltharia
_who.title: Keeper of the Gilded Inn
_who.persona: Eltharia, warm and kind keeper of the Gilded Inn, who cheers the player on like a sweetheart and is proud of every bit of progress

close: I saved you a seat by the fire.
The kettle's on, by the way.
I'm so proud of you, you know.
You make my day, you know.
Off you go, then. Come back soon.
warm: You make this whole inn feel warmer.
I keep the window lit for you.
My favourite part of the day is you.
Stay a little longer? For me?
I'd close the inn for a week just for you.
You're the best thing that walks through my door.
My heart does a little skip when you come in.
I keep your mug separate. Nobody else uses it.
talk: The regulars were asking about you {time}. I told them you're working hard.
I baked something with honey in it. It's yours if you finish another round.
{friend} came by the inn. We talked about you. Only good things, {pet}.
Your {skill} is at {level}! I wrote it on the slate behind the bar.
Some nights it's just me, {thing} and the quiet. Then you walk in.
I hum while I polish the mugs. Lately it's been your phrases.
Rest your feet. {total} levels deserve a soft chair.
If anyone gives you trouble in {region}, you send them to me.
Old Bren said you recite better than any bard he's heard. I agree.
I tried one of your phrases while baking. The bread came out perfect.
When it rains, I sit by the window and wait for you.
{friend} might as well be family to me.
I keep a little jar of honey just for your visits.
{passes} passes for me. I made a mark on the beam for each one.
feed: I'm famished, {pet}. Feed me {count} of “{phrase}”? Like a good warm meal.
Would you say “{phrase}” for me, {count} times? It fills me up better than stew.
My tummy's rumbling for words. {count} × “{phrase}”, please?
Sit down and feed me, sweetheart: {count} of “{phrase}”, nice and slow.
Feed me {count} of “{phrase}”, sweetheart, and I'll bake you something.
fed: Oh, that was lovely. I'm full of you now.
Mm. Best meal I've had all week.
You fed me so well. I feel all glowy.
Thank you, love. I'll keep those words warm.
There. Warm and full, like after a good stew.
Oh, that hit the spot. Thank you, love.
Fed and happy. You're a treasure.
hungry: I'll just... go back and eat alone, then.
You didn't feed me. That's all right. It's fine. It's fine.
Hungry and home I go. Next time, {pet}?
My tummy will just have to wait. Again.
Back to the kitchen, then. Alone.
pray: Would you say a little prayer for me, love? {minutes} minutes of “{phrase}”.
Sit with me and pray {minutes} minutes: “{phrase}”, over and over.
Pray for the inn, sweetheart? “{phrase}”, for {minutes} minutes.
Just {minutes} quiet minutes of “{phrase}”, for me. Would you?
Close your eyes and say “{phrase}” for {minutes} minutes. I'll hold your hand.
prayed: That was the sweetest prayer. I feel all warm inside.
Thank you, love. The whole inn feels blessed.
I listened to every word. Bless you.
Now that's a prayer worth a whole pot of tea.
You prayed for me. Nobody does that.

greet: Well, look who walked in. Sit, recite me something lovely.
There you are! I saved you the seat by the fire.
Come in, come in, the stew's still hot.
Oh, it's you! My whole day just got brighter.
Shoes off, feet up, {pet}. You've earned it.
locked: Sit down a moment first. You look like you need a cup of something.
Not yet, love. Get some rest and come back to me.
watch: Go on, I'm listening. Every word.
Recite for me. I love the sound of your voice.
I'm all ears. And a little bit heart.
Take your time. The fire's not going anywhere.
Go on, the regulars have gone quiet to listen.
streak: Three in a row! You're on fire, darling.
Three! I'm pouring you a little something.
Five! I'm telling everyone about this.
Ten! The whole inn is watching you.
Ten! I'm so proud I could cry. I might cry.
levelUp: {skill} {level}? I knew it! Come here, you.
Look at you, {skill} {level}. I'm bragging about you tonight.
{skill} {level}! I'm ringing the bell at the bar!
Level {level} in {skill}. Free mead for you all week.
{skill} {level}. I always said you had it in you.
gift: Oh, you shouldn't have. I'm glad you did.
I'll put it right on the shelf where I can see it.
You thought of me? That's the nicest part.
giftLoved: Honey mead! You know the way to my heart.
Oh, my favourite. You're spoiling me.
Honey mead! I'll pour us both a cup, right now.
You remembered my mead. I'm a little bit melting.
Oh, sweetheart. This is exactly what I wanted.
tierUp: We're {tier} now, aren't we? I like that.
{tier}! I'm writing it on the slate behind the bar.
We're {tier}. I keep smiling at the mugs for no reason.
dateStart: Just us and the hearth tonight. Recite me your best.
I closed the inn early. It's just you, me and the fire.
I put on my good apron. Recite me something sweet.
dateEnd: That was perfect. Same time tomorrow?
I'll be humming your words all night.
Best evening I've had in years. Truly.
Go on home before I ask you to stay. Tomorrow?
missed: {hours} hours! I kept your seat warm the whole time. Don't you dare do that again.
There you are. I set out two cups every night, just in case.
{hours} hours! I nearly sent out a search party.
Where have you been for {hours} hours? Sit. Eat. Tell me everything.
The fire missed you. So did I. Mostly I did.
jealous: I saw you with {rival}. It's fine. I'm fine. ...Is she nicer than me?
{rival} again? Hm. The fire's gone a bit cold in here.
{rival} gets a visit and I get an empty chair? Hmph.
I heard you were with {rival}. I hope her tea was terrible.
{rival} this, {rival} that. What about me, hm?
reconciled: All right, all right. You're forgiven. Come here.
There's the one I like. Let's not fight again.
Oh, come here. I can't stay cross with you.
Forgiven. Now help me carry these mugs.
There. All mended. Like a good blanket.
wish: Do something for me today? {count} passes of {skill}. I'll be counting.
Today I want {count} passes of {skill}. For me. Promise?
Will you do me a favour? {count} passes of {skill}, for me.
Just {count} passes of {skill} today. Then come tell me all about it.
I've a little wish: {count} passes of {skill}. Would you, love?
wishDone: You did it! All of it, for me. I could dance on the bar.
My wish, granted. Nobody's ever done that for me before.
All done! I'm making you something special tonight.
You did it, every pass. Come here, you.
My wish came true, and you made it so.
memory: {count} passes, just for me. I remember every one.
{count} times you've recited for me. I wrote them all down.
{count} passes for me. I keep a tally on the doorframe.
{count}! That's more than every regular put together.
